description: This is a library: composer.lock is not tracked, so there is no lock to maintain and lockFileMaintenance is deliberately absent. Renovate here bumps the composer.json constraints and the GitHub Actions versions instead.

Auto-merge: a PR merges automatically via GitHub native auto-merge once the required `build` check passes, which runs php-cs, PHPStan at level max and the suite at 100% coverage. That gate is strong enough to trust for a minor or patch bump.
MAJOR updates stay manual. A PHPUnit or PHPStan major reliably needs code changes, and a Symfony or Doctrine major warrants a spike.

packageRules.description: Keep major updates manual - they need review before merging.
